title: Gift Card Questions, What Discounts Do Nib Members Get on Their Portal?
body:
I looked at the wiki and if I understand correctly it shows 3 percent off for category choice grocery on the nib portal?
I don't have any nib products but I was able to sign up and I see some discounts like 9 percent on OPSM gift cards but I don't see the category choice grocery one. Has it been removed or do you need to be a member to get it?
I am aware of gifts.com through topcashback which is quite good.
Also, is it just me or does Google pay no longer allow you to add Coles prepaid MasterCards anymore? For using at online pages that have 3dsecure.
